description: Exercises the standalone 'pickup' action directly, in isolation from a full pick-and-place cycle. Explicitly passes open_position/close_position to match the 0=closed/1=open convention used elsewhere in this test suite (L2-L5) rather than relying on pickup()'s own internal defaults, which use the opposite convention (open_position default 0.0, close_position default 0.8) — a discovered inconsistency worth reconciling separately.

steps.description: Pick up red cube using the explicit open=1.0/close=0.0 convention
